sections.content_markdown: The set consisting of elements of two or more sets is said to be union of sets. Let, $A$ and $B$ be two sets. The union of sets $A$ and $B$ is denoted by $A \cup B$ and read as $A$ union $B$. In set building method $A \cup B = \{x : x \in A \text{ or } x \in B\}$

Example 8. If $C = \{3, 4, 5\}$ and $D = \{4, 6, 8\}$, determine $C \cup D$.

Solution: Given $C = \{3, 4, 5\}$
and $D = \{4, 6, 8\}$
$\therefore C \cup D = \{3, 4, 5\} \cup \{4, 6, 8\} = \{3, 4, 5, 6, 8\}$
The set to be determined is: $\{3, 4, 5, 6, 8\}$

The set consisting of common elements of two or more sets is known as intersection set. Let $A$ and $B$ be two sets. The intersection of sets $A$ and $B$ is denoted by $A \cap B$ and read as $A$ intersection $B$. In set building notation $A \cap B = \{x : x \in A \text{ and } x \in B\}$
Example 9. If $P = \{x \in N : 2 < x \leq 6\}$ and $Q = \{x \in N : x \text{ is even and } x \leq 8\}$, determine $P \cap Q$.
